title: We Love AMD Stock...But We'd Buy NVIDIA Here
creator: Couch Investor
summary: Hosted on Jose Najarro's channel with Neil (Couch Investor) as guest: a head-to-head debate forcing each to pick one stock to buy at current prices - AMD or Nvidia. Jose builds the Nvidia bull case (~105% most-recent-quarter revenue growth, analysts underestimating the Vera Rubin ramp, forward PE ~18.8, full-rack-scale innovation, GPU-as-an-asset financing edge, ~$240B expected free cash flow over the next four quarters) against bear points (hyperscaler custom silicon via Broadcom/Marvell, circular-financing criticism, power bottlenecks, AI-demand slowdown). Neil, fully positioned in AMD with only a couple of Nvidia shares, covers AMD's bull case (MI400/Helios rack ramp shipping end-September, chiplet innovation enabling custom variants like a Meta-specific MI450, OpenAI/Anthropic/Meta partnerships) but flags valuation as the key bear case (forward PE ~55 vs Nvidia's ~19) plus Helios execution/sentiment risk. Both conclude they would buy NVIDIA over AMD today on risk/reward, while stressing AMD can still move higher. Calls: NVDA BUY (Couch), AMD HOLD (Couch); host Jose Najarro also BUY NVDA. Note: auto-captions garble product names (LPX/CPX, 'Jalapeno' codename, 'Corwe' = CoreWeave); '$8 trillion AMD' likely garbled ($800B).

calls.thesis: Best risk/reward: ~90% expected growth at sub-20 forward PE; innovation plus GPU-as-an-asset financing moat.
calls.base: Analysts underestimating Vera Rubin ramp; ~$240B expected FCF over next 4 quarters.
calls.bull: Multiple re-rating as hyperscaler orders land; operating profit seen 3x by fiscal 29.
calls.bear: Hyperscaler custom silicon (Broadcom/Marvell); power bottlenecks; AI demand slowdown.
